newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans and soymeal tumble as funds sell.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans and soymeal tumble as funds sell.

text.p: CBOT soybean and soymeal futures fell sharply in fast dealings on fund and local liquidation which triggered sell stops, pit sources said.
"Funds are selling, locals are selling. They touched off stops when they dropped below yesterday's lows," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter.
Trade sources said stops were hit below $8.60 per bushel in the July. They said technical indicators were weakened by Monday's sharp break and the fundamental outlook offered little bullish input.
"Nobody's too concerned about the weather right now," a trader said. "It's only May."
At 1145 CDT soybeans were down 16-1/4 to 6-1/2 cents per bushel with July down 15 at $8.59-1/2. Soymeal was off $4.70 to $1.60 per ton with July off $4.70 at $286.00.
